svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut two 910 mm lengths of 15 x 15 x 2 angle; deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill four 4.5 mm holes in one leg (the upright leg), 7 from its

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: edge, at 50, 320, 590 and 860 from one end; countersink them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: on the inside of the east and west walls, centred along them,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the other leg pointing into the box. The top of the ledge is 44

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: above the wall bottom, level with the top of the bottom batten.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 4 x 25 countersunk stainless wood screws into the batten.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The tray deck rests on the two ledges (it is not screwed down).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: both ledges at the same height within 1 mm.
